titulo: He erased his name from Death's book 🐒 Sun Wukong Part 3 #story #shorts
descripcion:
Back home, the Monkey King cuts down the demon who slaughtered his people. No mortal weapon can hold his strength, so he walks into the Dragon King's palace under the sea and takes the iron pillar that once tamed the Great Flood. Then Death comes for him, and he opens the Book of Life and Death.

> Part 4: tomorrow. Follow so you don't miss it.
Would you have crossed out your own name?

From Journey to the West (Xiyouji), Wu Cheng'en, 16th century, chapter 3.
